section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant characteristics for a study conducted in Brazil. The study initially recruited 200 women from a private university in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, but excluded 6 participants (1 with breast cancer, 5 incomplete data), resulting in a final sample of 194 women with a mean age of 21.80 years (SD = 4.24), mean BMI of 23.99 kg/m² (SD = 4.94), and 88.7% self-identified as ethnically White.
